description: This file is part of the SuiteCRM upgrade process, specifically handling the commit phase of an upgrade or upgrade attempt. It manages backup creation, pre- and post-install scripts, file copying, cache clearing, database schema management, registration of the upgrade, and final output to the user. It also includes mechanisms for error handling, tracing, and session state management during the upgrade.

classes.name: SugarMerge
classes.description: Handles merging of module files during upgrade, located in modules/UpgradeWizard/SugarMerge/SugarMerge.php.

classes.name: UpgradeHistory
classes.description: Represents an upgrade record for registering upgrade history.

classes.name: SugarThemeRegistry
classes.description: Manages theme configurations, JS cache, and theme registry details.

methods.name: pre_install
methods.description: User-defined function to execute scripts before the main upgrade process.

methods.name: post_install
methods.description: User-defined function to execute scripts after the main upgrade process.

methods.name: UWrebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds the database schemas after upgrade.

methods.name: addNewSystemTabsFromUpgrade
methods.description: Incorporates new system tabs from the upgrade package.
